supported_scope: Finite monodromy of the geometric W and invariant lifts, conditional on the explicit global projective presentation, rational-singularity vanishing, canonical quotient, and standard topology.

claim_assessments.reason: The explicit embedding into the proper algebraic ambient T x P^M permits GAGA of the full coherent ideal and preserves nilpotents; arbitrary proper analytic family algebraization is not asserted.
Base-change lifting, coherent H^2 vanishing, the exponential sequence and whole-scheme-fiber GAGA give rational Chern-class spanning.

Countably many fixed-polynomial finite-type Quot loci provide universal line bundles; a very general point, path transport and finite generic multisections give finite-index stabilizers of a spanning list.
Curve duality gives coinvariants; finite rational monodromy supplies averaging and surjectivity on invariants.

invalid_extrapolations: Finite permutation experiments prove monodromy of W
